subtests.name: Encode video frame with orientation
Encode video frames with different orientation has non-fatal failures
Encode video frames with different orientations after reconfigure
The decoderConfig of an encoder fed with frames without orientation has no rotation and no flip
The decoderConfig of an encoder fed with frames with a rotation of 0 and flip false has the rotation and flip
The decoderConfig of an encoder fed with frames with a rotation of 0 and flip true has the rotation and flip
The decoderConfig of an encoder fed with frames with a rotation of 90 and flip false has the rotation and flip
The decoderConfig of an encoder fed with frames with a rotation of 90 and flip true has the rotation and flip
The decoderConfig of an encoder fed with frames with a rotation of 180 and flip false has the rotation and flip
The decoderConfig of an encoder fed with frames with a rotation of 180 and flip true has the rotation and flip
The decoderConfig of an encoder fed with frames with a rotation of 270 and flip false has the rotation and flip
The decoderConfig of an encoder fed with frames with a rotation of 270 and flip true has the rotation and flip
The decoderConfig has the normalized rotation of the frames
Encoding a frame without orientation after a frame with an orientation throws a DataError
Encoding a rotated frame after a frame without orientation throws a DataError
A frame rejected for its orientation does not prevent matching frames from being encoded
configure() resets the orientation expected by the encoder
A new decoderConfig is given when the orientation of the encoded frames changes after a configure() that changes only the bitrate
The decoderConfig of an output describes the orientation of its frame, not the orientation set by a later configure() that changes only the bitrate
The decoderConfig of an output does not depend on the timestamp of its frame with a configure() that changes only the bitrate
A new decoderConfig is given when the orientation of the encoded frames changes after a configure() that changes more than the bitrate
The decoderConfig of an output describes the orientation of its frame, not the orientation set by a later configure() that changes more than the bitrate
The decoderConfig of an output does not depend on the timestamp of its frame with a configure() that changes more than the bitrate
